title: MWS — RESURVEY_3YR table
description: Array of Million Women Study 3-year ('yellow') resurvey records. One element is one participant's 3-year follow-up record, combining the '3-year resurvey' sheet and the 'Dietary data at 3-year resurvey' sheet (same wave, same grain).
$comment: This table has no participant-identifier field in the source dictionary at all, same as the recruitment table (open item, see DECISIONS.md D007/D047) -- uniqueItems is asserted as standing structural policy but cannot anchor to a real key here, and there is currently no way to link a resurvey_3yr row back to its recruitment row for the same participant.

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern: never used HRT means start age, duration, and type are structurally not applicable -- D052, mirrors the recruitment table's confirmed D039 pattern. Deliberately does NOT include F1HTNPC=4 ('Ever, status not known') -- steward-confirmed to stay unconstrained, D052.
Applicability: a participant who has ever used HRT (Past or Current) must have real values for start age, duration, and type -- D052.
HRT routing: a participant currently using HRT has not stopped, so time-since-last-used is structurally not applicable -- D052.
Applicability: a participant who stopped using HRT in the past must have a real value for time-since-last-used -- D052.

Skip pattern: the real questionnaire's smoking-status question is 'have you ever been a smoker?' -- a Never answer means the participant skips the cigarettes-per-day follow-up entirely, so it is structurally not applicable -- D062, corrects D060.

Applicability: a participant who has ever smoked (Past or Current) must have a real answer for cigarettes-per-day -- D062. '1=None' remains a valid real answer here, e.g. a past/current smoker who reports zero on average -- steward-confirmed this is left untouched, not remapped.

Skip pattern: mother alive means age-when-died and all 7 cause-of-death fields are structurally not applicable -- D071. Deliberately does NOT include F1MALIVE=3 ('Do not know') -- steward-confirmed to stay unconstrained, D071.
Applicability: a participant whose mother is alive must have a real answer for mother's current age -- D071.
Skip pattern: mother deceased means her current age is structurally not applicable -- D071.

Applicability: a participant whose mother has died must have a real answer for her age at death -- D071. The 7 cause-of-death fields are deliberately NOT required non-777 here -- checkbox semantics mean most are legitimately non-1 for any given deceased mother.
Skip pattern: no partner means whether the partner smokes is structurally not applicable -- D073.
Applicability: a participant who currently has a partner must have a real answer for whether that partner smokes -- D073.

Skip pattern: no medication used in the last 4 weeks means all 19 specific medication fields are structurally not applicable -- D075, same shape as parental_mortality's F1MALIVE gate (D071). No applicability rule is added in the other direction -- checkbox semantics mean most of the 19 fields are legitimately non-1 for any given participant even when F1MED=1, same reasoning as the cause-of-death block.
